value.rationale: The length of the admissible arc is a geometrically natural control parameter. Its sharp 4π/3 transition changes optimizer contact and dimension, inducing different rare-area exponents with exact coefficients and conditional shape laws. These are nontrivial, experimentally testable properties of a canonical sampling model and naturally illuminate geometric boundary constraints.
